name: kxusairanagreement
title: Will the US and Iran agree to a new nuclear deal before Mar 1, 2027?
settlement: Resolves Yes if the United States has agreed to, signed, or accepted a formal written agreement with Iran (multilateral is fine if the US participates) that imposes verifiable restrictions on Iran's nuclear program and lifts, suspends, or modifies at least one US economic sanction. Both governments publicly and officially agreeing to the terms is sufficient even if formal signing has not happened.
decideContext: Estimate how this news changes the probability, in percentage points, that a qualifying US-Iran nuclear agreement is agreed, signed, or accepted before the market's deadline. The markets are nested 'before date X' deadlines, so an earlier deal also resolves every later deadline Yes.
